GK-012 accepted completion split r5 — 2026-10-05

Sasha explicitly replied "yes" to the proposed completion split, updates to affected tickets and marking GK-012 Done. This supersedes the r4 instruction to keep this setup card open for implementation checks.

Accepted GK-012 scope: purchased Cloudflare domain gkcake.com; reported DNS access, auto-renewal/valid payment, MFA and Elina recovery; approved site/admin/API/staging addresses and GK Cakes <orders@gkcake.com> with Gmail Reply-To; confirmed @gk.cake.london control; approved "Copy request & open Instagram" interaction/fallback; reported chat-opening checks on Mac/web, iPhone/app and Android (app/browser detail not supplied); agent public DNS checks; accepted and published handoff. Full decisions remain in the preceding r4 comments.

Required downstream acceptance, retained rather than waived:
- GK-020 https://trello.com/c/W8q5svCh : concrete runtime/environment inventory and bootstrap config; supply actual origin/local-development values to GK-021.
- GK-021 https://trello.com/c/zEfCJtWD : derive/configure exact login callbacks and allowlists; prove accepted callbacks succeed and invalid/foreign redirects are rejected. No production wildcard or invented callback path.
- GK-027 https://trello.com/c/G8hLmSBU : reconcile K02/specifications with the approved handle and combined action before implementation; test copy/open/paste and clipboard/Instagram failure fallback on supported devices, retaining summary/reference and no DM-sent claim.

AC1 setup evidence accepted. AC2 account/opening evidence and interaction policy accepted; full implementation proof belongs to GK-027. AC3 approved address inventory accepted; exact callbacks and denial tests belong to GK-020/021. AC4 is this explicit scoped acceptance and revision-linked publication, with downstream assignments verified before Done.

No application tests, independent review, deployment or direct new Elina approval are claimed. Other tickets retain their existing dependencies/status/gates. Only GK-012 is authorized to move to Done.

Source: docs/creator/GK-012/closure-scope-2026-10-05.md (r5), SHA-256 eb5cc4e9d77d50cf58a9de7a5c6ecc123fd99eacb3f16ae526dc2e1fb855808a

GK-012 accepted decision/setup handoff r4 — part 2/2

Remaining technical work: coordinate exact login callbacks/environment settings
with GK-020/021 when the implementation exists; reconcile K02/GK-027 with the approved
combined interaction; test copy/open/paste and fallback on supported devices.
These remain explicit and are not waived or represented as passed.

AC1 evidence collected; AC2/AC3 partial for the named technical gaps. AC4 records
Sasha's acceptance and this authorized publication; remaining technical evidence
is still required. Keep GK-012 open pending that evidence.
No implementation, deployment, independent review or direct new Elina approval
is claimed. Detailed source: docs/creator/GK-012/README.md, interview r4.

Source SHA-256 (interview r4 before publication receipt): 16d53052cb163e2113af1dc9823d45e78eca6f1da7439743f4d9f95610887e08

GK-012 accepted decision/setup handoff r4 — part 1/2

GK-012 decision/setup handoff — interview r4, 2026-10-05

Sasha explicitly accepted this consolidated handoff and authorized publishing it
to GK-012 while keeping the ticket open. This is not a Done claim.

Domain: gkcake.com purchased through Cloudflare. Sasha confirms DNS management
access, automatic renewal with valid payment, two-factor authentication and Elina's
ability to recover/manage the domain if Sasha is unavailable. Sasha administers;
the business owner funds it. No additional registration or purchase was performed.

Approved HTTPS addresses:
- Customer site: gkcake.com; www.gkcake.com redirects to it.
- Admin: gkcake.com/admin, sharing the UI deployment with staff authorization.
- Production API: api.gkcake.com.
- Test UI/admin: staging.gkcake.com and staging.gkcake.com/admin.
- Test API: staging-api.gkcake.com; separate test credentials and synthetic data.

Email: GK Cakes <orders@gkcake.com>; Reply-To gk.cake.london@gmail.com for order
and login emails. Sasha explicitly chose GK Cakes to resolve the GK-011 conflict.
The GK-011 current selection is amended; its old GK Cake London test evidence is
preserved. Provider settings were not changed by this documentation update.

Instagram: Elina controls @gk.cake.london and can log in/read DMs, reported by Sasha.
Use https://ig.me/m/gk.cake.london. Sasha approves “Copy request & open Instagram”:
one tap attempts to copy the summary and open the DM; customer pastes and sends.
Retain selectable summary/request reference for manual copying and retry. General
contact links can open the DM directly. No assumed text-prefill or DM-sent claim.

Reported link-opening results: Mac opens the correct DM in Instagram web; iPhone
opens the DM in the Instagram app; Android success reported in response to the
Android check, without app/browser detail. These do not test the combined button,
clipboard, pasting or failure fallback, and were not independently observed.

Agent public-DNS checks passed for both Cloudflare nameservers, the rsend/send
CNAMEs and the resend._domainkey TXT key, matching Sasha's export. This establishes
published DNS, not private registration/account settings or email delivery.
